title: Quantitative Stability and Numerical Resolution of the Moment Measure Problem
summary: The moment measure problem consists in finding a convex function $ψ$ whose moment measure, i.e., the pushforward by $\nabla ψ$ of the measure with density $e^{-ψ(\,\cdot\,)}$, is prescribed. It is highly non-linear and less understood than the related optimal transport problem. We establish a quantitative stability estimate for this problem. This estimate validates, as well as leads us to introduce, an approach to the numerical resolution of the moment measure problem inspired by semi-discrete optimal transport, consisting in approximating the prescribed measure by a finitely supported one.…
